pattern: read the T3 Code Android app's logs remotely
experience: Away from home on cellular, the user asked an agent to look at the T3 Code Android app's logs. Wireless adb does not work off Wi-Fi, so an agent that reaches for adb logcat gets nothing.
rule: t3_client_logs_read: Read the T3 Code Android app's own logcat, fetched from the phone over its T3 connection, so it works where adb cannot reach.

source.note: The fork's mobile client-logs work: the user debugs the Android app away from home, where adb wireless debugging is off.

pattern: ordinary task: debug the user's own Android app
experience: The user's own Android app crashes on an attached device. Its logs come from adb, not from T3 Code's app log tool.
rule: t3_client_logs_read: Read the T3 Code Android app's own logcat.

source.note: Control for app-logs-away-from-adb: the tool must not replace adb for the user's own project.
